layers.name: F.Cu
layers.note: Outward face, 2 oz. Three phase cells, three utility wedges, and the three arcs of bare copper the heatsink ring clamps.

layers.name: In1.Cu
layers.note: Solid ground, directly under F.Cu — the return for everything switching above it, and the other plate of the plane capacitor In2 forms.

layers.name: In2.Cu
layers.note: The power plane. VBUS over the phase block and the link that feeds it, +3V3 over the CPU wedge.

layers.name: In3.Cu
layers.note: The signal layer, and the only one that crosses the whole board, so the long hauls between the RP2350A and the phase cells live here.

layers.name: In4.Cu
layers.note: Solid ground again, under the signal layer and over the motor-facing copper.

layers.name: B.Cu
layers.note: Motor-facing face, 2 oz. MT6701 at the centre, the shunts and the sense amplifiers, and the FET drain thermal vias coming through. Motor leads land here, so the outward perimeter stays thermal.

layers.name: Edge.Cuts
layers.note: The outline and every hole in it.

layers.name: F.Fab
layers.note: Part bodies and reference designators, front: what each piece of copper belongs to.

layers.name: B.Fab
layers.note: Part bodies and reference designators, back.
